stop_reason: If a dedicated environment requires user-level Windows administrative approval, installation, account creation or access changes, stop at that operation and report the minimum manual action needed.

manual_action.minimum_manual_action: Install a local VM runtime compatible with Windows Home using Windows administrator approval; then report the installed runtime. No dataset permission change, edition upgrade or cloud rental is requested.
manual_action.example: VirtualBox base runtime; installer/version/license must be checked before installation. No Extension Pack is required for this workflow.
manual_action.alternative: User-provided existing isolated VM with no host drive shares; assess before use.
manual_action.after_install: Next agent stage creates a dedicated guest, stages only frozen permitted train/validation/observations, keeps source/truth/backups outside guest, and verifies exact worker access. No training on installation alone.

guest_proposal.shares: No host home/drive/parent shares; no shared clipboard/drag-drop; input delivered through readonly isolated staging; distinct writable output disk.
guest_proposal.evaluation: Separate context, receives completed outputs and test truth only after reconstruction; no write access to guest training/config/checkpoint stores.

manual_action.no_permission_mutations: Original source/test/backups remain untouched; dedicated staging only.

next_executable_stage: P3_ISOLATED_ENVIRONMENT_BOOTSTRAP after user installsVMruntime; no modeltrainingauthorization implied.
report_commit_note: This report is committed in the subsequent revision-only commit; obtain itsSHA via gitlog --all --grep ReleaseFixP3. Self-hashing commitSHA cannot be embedded in itself.
